# TALOS.DESIGN

> Digital infrastructure, 24/7 AI sales & inquiry assistants, and workflow automation studio engineered in Jhansi, Uttar Pradesh, India, serving regional MSMEs and growing businesses.

TALOS.DESIGN builds high-converting digital presence, bespoke operational platforms, and practical automation pipelines. The studio focuses on measurable business outcomes, speed, and eliminating manual operational bottlenecks.

---

## Core Services

What TALOS.DESIGN builds and deploys for clients:

- **High-Converting Web Design**: Sub-second loading, mobile-first websites designed for brand authority, search discoverability (SEO), and lead generation with direct WhatsApp integration.
  - URL: https://talos.design/services/web-design
  - Overview: https://talos.design/services
- **AI Sales & Inquiry Assistants**: Deployable AI-powered assistants that answer routine customer questions, capture inquiries, qualify prospects, and route conversations to human team members 24 hours a day on web and WhatsApp.
  - URL: https://talos.design/services/chatbots
  - Overview: https://talos.design/services
- **Workflow & Operations Automation**: Operational logic pipelines that connect payment gateways, CRMs, automated invoicing, and communication channels to eliminate repetitive administrative work.
  - URL: https://talos.design/services/automation
  - Overview: https://talos.design/services

---

## Engagement Packages

Productized rollout protocols for how clients engage TALOS.DESIGN:

- **Package 01 — Digital Business Launch**: Complete online presence package including custom website engineering, brand identity, SEO setup, and WhatsApp lead capture. Fixed price, 2-4 week delivery.
  - URL: https://talos.design/packages/presence
- **Package 02 — Automated Growth Engine**: Complete growth stack adding 24/7 AI WhatsApp sales assistant and automated CRM/billing synchronization. Most popular package.
  - URL: https://talos.design/packages/automation
- **Package 03 — Custom Business Platform**: Bespoke software architectures, internal management portals, and custom operational pipelines. Tailored scope, fixed pricing.
  - URL: https://talos.design/packages/custom
- **All Packages Overview**: https://talos.design/packages

---

## Specialized Industry Solutions

Pre-built, deployable vertical software platforms that TALOS.DESIGN can customize and deploy for specific industries. These are reusable products, not one-off client projects:

- **Hospitality & Heritage Properties**: Direct booking engines, room galleries, WhatsApp reservations, and OTA commission reduction for hotels and resorts.
  - URL: https://talos.design/solutions/hospitality
- **E-Commerce & Retail**: Multi-channel inventory automation, real-time ERP synchronization, and sub-second catalog performance for online stores.
  - URL: https://talos.design/solutions/ecommerce
- **Appointment & Slot-Based Businesses**: Automated client booking, inquiry qualification, appointment scheduling, and customer management for clinics, salons, and consultancies.
  - URL: https://talos.design/solutions/appointments
- **MediLife — Diagnostic Clinic Platform**: Talos.design's deployable diagnostic lab software featuring branded online test booking, pathologist peer-review verification, and one-click WhatsApp PDF report dispatch. Available for deployment to diagnostic clinics.
  - URL: https://talos.design/solutions/medilife
- **All Solutions Overview**: https://talos.design/solutions

## Engineering Expertise

How TALOS.DESIGN engineers technology — technical capabilities and demonstrations:

- **AI Assistants & Language Systems**: Conversational assistant design, prompt engineering, RAG pipelines with company knowledge bases, WhatsApp Business API integration, and rule-based human escalation.
  - Section: https://talos.design/expertise#ai
- **Systems Architecture**: API design, PostgreSQL with row-level security, event-driven pipelines, RBAC authentication, cloud infrastructure, and background job orchestration.
  - Section: https://talos.design/expertise#systems
- **Visual & Frontend Engineering**: Design tokens, fluid typography, physics-based motion, hardware-accelerated WebGL shaders, Core Web Vitals optimization, and semantic TypeScript architecture.
  - Section: https://talos.design/expertise#designs
- **Expertise Overview**: https://talos.design/expertise
